name: Gaines Residence

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a driveway that leads through dense trees to the residence. The property is located in a wooded residential neighborhood adjacent to the Deschutes River, with road access from Shoshone Road. Tree density may impact emergency vehicle and personnel movement around the structure.
